explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1052. Proper unitary divisors are the d ∈ [1, n) with d | n and gcd(d, n/d) = 1, and n ≥ 1 is unitary perfect when it equals their sum. The question 'only finitely many?' is stated as finiteness of the set. The test lemmas confirm the known examples 6, 60, 90, 87360 and 146361946186458562560000 (the first four are proved by decide), so the definition is calibrated against OEIS A002827.
